## Christmas menu-and-gift shortlist

### Starter direction — **elegant, make-ahead seafood table**
I opened three Sainsbury’s product pages for visual comparison:

- **Sainsbury’s Scottish Smoked Salmon & Maple Terrine, Taste the Difference (375g)** — **£7.50** / **£5.60 with Nectar**; serves 5. Smoked Scottish salmon and soft-cheese mousse with maple mousse, orange zest and pink peppercorns. **Best pick:** it looks like a proper festive starter, is ready to eat, and feels polished rather than fussy. *(Left open.)*
- **Sainsbury’s Smoky Cheddar & Tomato Antipasti, Taste the Difference (160g)** — **£4**. Semi-dried tomatoes, smoky cheddar and green olives in garlic-parsley dressing. **Cosy grazing option:** use alongside gluten-free crackers or veg for a relaxed, Mediterranean-style first course. Its listed ingredients don’t include gluten cereals, but check the pack’s dietary label before serving anyone coeliac.
- **Sainsbury’s Free From Lightly Salted Christmas Tree Tortilla Chips (200g)** — **89p**. Explicitly labelled gluten-free maize snacks. **Party-food option:** inexpensive, genuinely Christmas-shaped and ideal with dips; a nice nibble while the main meal finishes.

**Full-menu picture:** choose the **salmon-and-maple terrine** as the starter, then serve the spiral ham as the warm, celebratory centrepiece. Keep the ham moist while reheating rather than treating it as a raw roast, and finish it with a sweet-savoury glaze; the maple, citrus and peppercorn notes in the terrine would lead neatly into that glossy, festive ham course. I tried to retrieve The Kitchn’s specific spiral-ham article, but its site returned an automation-access block, so I have not presented the cooking method above as a verified Kitchn summary.

### Dad stocking fillers — M&S, all under £20
- **Solutions for Men The Body Spray & Socks Duo** — **£8**. Bergamot, cardamom and sandalwood body spray plus striped ankle socks. **Best all-round stocking filler:** practical, gift-ready and more useful than a novelty. *(Left open.)*
- **Autograph Faux Leather Sunglasses Case** — **£10**. Magnetic closure, lens cloth and carrying rope. **Best useful option:** understated and properly practical; the strongest choice for someone who already has grooming products. *(Left open.)*
- **Solutions for Men Energise and Refresh Body Spray Set** — **£8**. Two portable body sprays intended for body or clothing. **Easy crowd-pleaser:** simple, affordable and suited to a group of guests.

### Slightly more polished Boots backups
- **Baylis & Harding Black Pepper & Ginseng His Essential Luxuries Gift Set** — **£16**. Men’s fragranced-grooming gift set; currently in Boots’ selected Christmas 3-for-2 offer. This is the more gift-box-like alternative to the M&S stocking fillers.
- **Osprey London Body Spray Duo — Bergamot, Vetiver & Leather** — **£10**. A two-spray fragrance option, also listed in the selected Boots Christmas 3-for-2 offer. **Best Boots value backup** if you want a more masculine fragrance-led gift.

I left the salmon terrine page and the two strongest M&S gift pages open for direct photo/name comparison. Prices and offers can change, so give the product pages a quick final check before ordering.

- **Sainsbury’s Free From Lightly Salted Christmas Tree Tortilla Chips (200g)** — **89p**. Explicitly labelled gluten-free maize snacks. **Party-food option:** inexpensive, genuinely Christmas-shaped and ideal with dips; a nice nibble while the main meal finishes.

Keep the ham moist while reheating rather than treating it as a raw roast, and finish it with a sweet-savoury glaze; the maple, citrus and peppercorn notes in the terrine would lead neatly into that glossy, festive ham course. - **Solutions for Men Energise and Refresh Body Spray Set** — **£8**. Two portable body sprays intended for body or clothing. **Easy crowd-pleaser:** simple, affordable and suited to a group of guests.

### Slightly more polished Boots backups
- **Baylis & Harding Black Pepper & Ginseng His Essential Luxuries Gift Set** — **£16**. Men’s fragranced-grooming gift set; currently in Boots’ selected Christmas 3-for-2 offer. This is the more gift-box-like alternative to the M&S stocking fillers.
- **Osprey London Body Spray Duo — Bergamot, Vetiver & Leather** — **£10**. A two-spray fragrance option, also listed in the selected Boots Christmas 3-for-2 offer. **Best Boots value backup** if you want a more masculine fragrance-led gift.

I left the salmon terrine page and the two strongest M&S gift pages open for direct photo/name comparison. Prices and offers can change, so give the product pages a quick final check before ordering.
